how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-mountain-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3906:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:3906:details:0: The elders have felt a disturbance amongst the elements. The Dark Iron dwarves have summoned a foul spirit into our world that threatens to plague our lands with an eternal draught. This disharmony of flame must be investigated.
rows.quest:3906:details:1: BTravel to Blackrock Mountain, through the Chasm of Flame, into the quarry. It is there that you shall find this lord of fire: Overmaster Pyron.
rows.quest:3906:details:2: BEnd the disruption and return to me.
rows.quest:3906:completion:0: This cannot be... it must not be. The destruction of Pyron has merely lifted a veil. Within the depths of Blackrock is a much more insidious source of corruption.
rows.quest:4262:obj:0: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
rows.quest:4262:obj:1: BYou recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?
rows.quest:4262:details:0: The last five of my mages that went snooping around in Blackrock Mountain came back extra crispy with a permanent orange gnomefro - or worse.
rows.quest:4262:details:1: B<Jalinda picks up some ashes from the ground and releases them into the air.>
rows.quest:4262:details:2: BOne nasty bugger in particular, Overmaster Pyron, seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. We need that elemental terminated so that our expedition crew can make its way into Blackrock Depths!
rows.quest:4262:details:3: BHe guards the entrance at the Blackrock Quarry.
rows.quest:8960:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:8960:details:0: So we need to recover the rest of the medallion? Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache. He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.
rows.quest:8960:details:1: BI'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
rows.quest:8960:completion:0: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!
rows.quest:8960:completion:1: BWill you help us, ⟦2⟧? Help to undo the wrong that we perpetrated and put things to right? If it's true that you already have the Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, then I think I can point you in the right direction to acquire the other two parts, reunite them and put an end to all of this.
rows.quest:8960:completion:2: BOh, by the way, hello, my name is Bodley. Nice to meet you!
rows.quest:8961:obj:0: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
rows.quest:8961:details:0: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.
rows.quest:8961:details:1: BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and ⟦E2⟧ of Cynders in ⟦E3⟧, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
rows.quest:8961:completion:0: I'm impressed, ⟦3⟧, but there's no time to lose. I will give you your next task, because you will still need to acquire a few more important components before we can proceed.
rows.quest:8961:completion:1: BSpeak to me again when you feel that you are ready for the challenge that lies ahead.
rows.quest:8962:obj:0: Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
rows.quest:8962:details:0: ⟦4⟧, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.
rows.quest:8962:details:1: BMor Grayhoof, our most prominent druid, had many close friends amongst the Cenarion Circle, some of which have fallen to the silithid. I need you to retrieve some Druidical Remains from the silithid that inhabit the environs of Hive'Regal in southeastern ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8962:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦5⟧. I will imbue the essence of the remains into the brazier.
rows.quest:8962:completion:1: BNow all that is left is to go to the lower portion of Blackrock Spire, to the chamber where War Master ⟦E4⟧ resides in Tazz'Alaor, and use the brazier to summon forth the corrupted spirit of my former cohort, Mor Grayhoof. He cannot rest until the amulet piece is taken from him.

rows.quest:8964:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦9⟧. I will imbue the essence of the sword into the brazier.
rows.quest:8964:completion:1: BNow all that is left is to get into The Crimson Throne inside The ⟦E10⟧ Bastion at ⟦E11⟧, and use the brazier to summon forth the remains of my former cohorts, Jarien and Sothos. rows.quest:8965:completion:1: BNow all that is left is to get into Scholomance, to Ras Frostwhisper's chamber, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Kormok. rows.quest:8994:obj:0: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
rows.quest:8994:details:0: We're nearly there, ⟦21⟧. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth Lord Valthalak.
rows.quest:8994:details:1: BTo begin I must ask you to journey forth into Blackrock Spire and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a Flask of Supreme Power.
rows.quest:8994:completion:0: That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon Lord Valthalak, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.
rows.quest:8994:completion:1: BYou've come quite a distance, ⟦23⟧, don't falter now that the end is in sight!
rows.quest:8996:obj:0: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8996:details:0: I will ignore your impertinence this time, ⟦24⟧, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, ⟦25⟧, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!
rows.quest:8996:details:1: BReturn to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
rows.quest:8996:completion:0: He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.
rows.quest:8996:completion:1: BThis is a great day, ⟦26⟧! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.
rows.quest:8996:completion:2: BThank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.
rows.quest:9032:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
rows.quest:9032:details:0: The medallion contained Valthalak's soul? It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.
rows.quest:9032:details:1: BLocating Bodley presents a bit of a problem. Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire. He was never heard of again.
rows.quest:9032:details:2: BSeek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now. I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
rows.quest:9032:completion:0: I am so glad that you can see me. Finally someone to talk to!
